text:
Ethan: Heads-up — planning a non-critical deploy to the Dedicated 'starlight' GPU slice tonight. Target start 21:00 UTC. Patch is autoscale-policy v1.4.2 (smoother downscale + safer min-floor).
Sasha: Sounds good. Who's on rollout duty?
Ethan: @Sasha you and @Anya for rollout. @Kevin is on rollback and post-smoke metrics. Maria will watch logs. ops-bot: scheduled window recorded (deploy_id=starlight-2026-03-18-21). :white_check_mark: 
Anya: Confirming — I'll own the canary group (slice-3). Plan: 1) deploy policy to canary pool 2) 15m smoke 3) if OK, ramp to remaining slices in 10m waves.
Kevin: What are the smoke pass/fail gates? Need clear thresholds.
Ethan: Good call. Gates: CPU/GPU util < 85% avg, p95 latency change < +30ms, no >3% increase in request errors, cache-hit ratio >= baseline-2%. If any gate fails -> immediate rollback to previous policy and notify #eng-oncall.
Maria: I'll tail the infra logs and set an alert rule for policy-eval anomalies. Posting quick command for smoke (use from bastion):
```bash
# check recent slice metrics
rcli metrics --slice starlight --range 15m --series p95_latency,gpu_util,errors
# check autoscale decisions
rcli policy inspect starlight --revision v1.4.2
```
Sasha: During canary I'll run a small synthetic workload (ramp to 40% of target qps for 10m). If latency holds, proceed.
Anya: Rollback steps (if needed):
1) run `rcli policy rollback starlight --to v1.4.1`
2) set min-scale override: `rcli pool set-min starlight 2 --temporary`
3) notify customers (prepped blurb in #support-digest)
Kevin: I'll be ready to flip rollback within 3 minutes if gates fail. Also please keep the duration of canary to at least 15m but not more than 30m to reduce blast radius.
Ethan: Ops checklist for tonight:
- @Sasha deploy to canary 21:00 UTC
- @Anya run synthetic workload and monitor 21:05–21:20 UTC
- @Kevin watch rollback triggers and tracing 21:00–21:40 UTC
- @Maria tail infra logs and metrics, post summary 21:25 UTC
- Post final thumbs-up in this thread before full rollout
Sasha: Quick QA question — does v1.4.2 change min-scale semantics? I thought it allowed fractional decisions for smoother scale-down.
Ethan: It doesn't change min-scale hard floor, only decreases downscale aggressiveness and adds an extra cooldown. Min-scale remains honored.
Anya: Noted. Also I'll attach the smoke runbook snippet to the deploy ticket.
ops-bot: deploy window reminder scheduled for 20:50 UTC.
Kevin: One more ask — can we enable temporary extra logging for the autoscaler for the canary only? Add `AS_LOG=debug` to policy env for slice-3.
Ethan: Yes, do that only for canary. Make sure logs auto-rotate after 30m.
Maria: Copy — I'll watch for noise and drop logs after canary.
Sasha: All green from me. Will ping here at 21:04 with canary results. :rocket:
Anya: If canary passes, rollout start 21:30 UTC in 10m waves. If anything odd, we stop and rollback.
Ethan: Thanks everyone. If you don't hear from me, follow rollback steps above. I'll be reachable on phone.
Kevin: Ping me if alerts fire; I'll take action.
Sasha: 21:04 — canary initial pass: p95 +12ms, gpu_util stable, errors unchanged. Proceeding to ramp to next wave.
Anya: 21:12 — canary full 15m passed. Starting staged rollout now.
Maria: 21:25 — post-smoke summary: all gates within thresholds, no anomalous logs.
Ethan: Final: full rollout complete, closing window. Thanks team. :tada:
